class StackUnderflowError < StandardError; end

class Stack
  def initialize
    @store = []
  end

  private :@store

  public

  def push(item)
    @store << item
  end

  def pop
    raise StackUnderflowError, 'Stack is empty' if empty?
    @store.pop
  end

  def peek
    raise StackUnderflowError, 'Stack is empty' if empty?
    @store.last
  end

  def empty?
    @store.empty?
  end
end
